meta.name: Baratie
meta.description: Los Sombrero de Paja parten hacia el restaurante marítimo, Baratie, con la esperanza de reclutar a uno de sus cocineros. Mientras, una hambrienta, pero poderosa fuerza asedia al restaurante cuando un amenazante espadachín del Grand Line se aproxima.

videos.title: Enter: Sanji
videos.overview: The Straw Hats happen across Zoro's former partners, Yosaku and Johnny, whose dietary dilemma reminds the pirates they still need a cook on their ship. Thus, they set sail for the sea restaurant Baratie, hoping to snag a chef.

videos.title: Pirate Commodore Don Krieg
videos.overview: Luffy is on hiatus from pirating to work as a cabin boy to pay off the damage done to the Baratie. While he tries to convince Sanji to join his crew, the pirate Gin brings the infamous Don Krieg and his starving forces to the sea restaurant.

videos.title: The Oath
videos.overview: As Nami steals the Going Merry, Hawk-Eye Mihawk, known far and wide as the world's greatest swordsman, arrives all the way from the Grand Line to finish off Don Krieg. However, Zoro challenges the deadly Mihawk to a duel in order to achieve his dream.

videos.title: Pearl
videos.overview: Mihawk departs after defeating Zoro, and Krieg continues his assault on the Baratie. Pearl, one of Krieg's strongest men, goes on the offensive with fiery attacks and multiple shields at his disposal, so Sanji reveals his unique fighting style.

videos.title: Because of a Dream
videos.overview: Sanji continues to battle Pearl, but Gin cleverly holds Chef Zeff hostage, forcing Sanji an impossible situation. Sanji's childhood memories flood his mind, and he reflects on why Zeff means so much to him.

videos.title: MH5
videos.overview: In a surprising twist, Gin finishes Pearl off himself, claiming Sanji as his own target. Though still wounded, Sanji rises to the challenge and faces off with Gin. As the battle draws to a close, Don Krieg unleashes a deadly toxin into the air.

videos.title: The Stalwart War Spear
videos.overview: The struggle with Krieg nears its end. Luffy's fighting spirit is unwavering, even after taking several hits from Krieg's Stalwart War Spear. Straw Hat’s strategy shifts to smashing through Krieg’s defenses and attacking the spear head-on.

videos.title: The Fourth
videos.overview: As the dust of battle settles, the still poisoned Gin decides to go back to the Grand Line with Krieg, and Sanji makes the difficult decision to join Luffy's crew. Suddenly, Yosaku returns with news of where Nami took the Going Merry.
